bank.controller_population: exact frozen historical-31 plus fresh-16 identities
bank.maximin_ties: lexicographic controller identity under the frozen implementation
bank.shell_choice: per-controller full-development Q3.0 lexicographic rule: accuracy, evaluability, lower mean tokens, MEDIUM tie preference

champion.rule: highest pooled correctness; then evaluability; then lower mean generated tokens; then lexicographic policy identity

router.hyperparameter_rule: componentwise median/mode of the five Q3.1 outer-fold GEOMETRY_BLIND_POLICY_ID choices; no full-panel performance lookup
router.pca: fit once on all 300 closed development representations; persist mean, components, and score scales
router.targets: mean correctness across the two closed rollouts for each bank policy

routes: hybrid public source programs with prospectively generated new inputs

future_primary.comparison: frozen routed A0 portfolio versus frozen best single champion
future_primary.paired_by: family and rollout index, without assuming RNG coupling from equal numeric seeds
future_primary.secondary_geometry_attribution: matched-random-bank analysis only; cannot rescue primary utility

candidate_tests: one-sided studentized family sign-flip randomization test
exact discordant-pair binomial test for R=1 diagnostic
power_precision.endpoint: family-weighted mean of rollout-mean routed-minus-champion correctness
method_selection: FPR upper Wilson limit <= 0.065 in all prespecified null scenarios
95% interval coverage >= 0.93 in all regular scenarios
family is the independent inference unit
power >= 0.80 for +0.03 under the designated conservative scenario
smaller interval width only after calibration
power_precision.paired_seed_interpretation: same numeric seed is not assumed to induce valid common-random-number coupling for divergent autoregressive policies

route_decision.I: Tier B only: eligible and adequately powered bounded internal validation
route_decision.II: fully fresh: defensible fresh exact-evaluator instrument and Tier B inadequate or too exposed
route_decision.III: Tier B de-risking followed by unchanged fresh evaluation when both are independently justified
route_decision.if_adaptation_after_tier_b: newly freeze the later instrument; Tier B remains development-only

tier_b_audit.bounded_internal_validation_eligibility: A or B only; no exact final-policy outcome, router access, manual inspection, or design influence
tier_b_audit.confirmatory_eligibility: A only, with no unresolved provenance

strata.B: prompt touched only by model-free parser/provenance tooling; no human raw-content inspection and no generation
strata.C: model generation under unrelated conditions, with correctness never scored or inspected
strata.D: correctness or semantic outcome scored/inspected under unrelated conditions
strata.F: possible influence on final bank, router, parser, metric, threshold, protocol, or exact candidate-policy outcome

tier_b_route_gate.purpose: bounded internal validation only; never fresh confirmatory evidence

upper_bound_clarification.q3_2_outcome_optimized_bank: upper bound on bank opportunity/construction under outer-training-only selection
